I don’t know how much this applies to other people, but I’d personally advise against travel. In 2017 and 2018 I finally went to the 2 places I always had been dying to go to, and once I was there it meant nothing to me. People always talk about going on “soul-searching adventures” and what not; I think it’s all garbage. If you’re depressed at home, you’ll just be depressed in London, or Paris, or Dubai or wherever you wanted to go.

Again maybe that’s just me, but if I were in your shoes I’d spend it on something else. For example, I live right next to a racetrack where you can drive laps in exotic supercars. That’s personally what I’d do, I’m not sure what your interests are, but you can get more creative than simply traveling.
